session_selection.time_basis: Selected root UTC first event and operator-selected last completed assistant/task_complete.
session_selection.rationale: Primary root and descendants; selected final response dated Aug 16 claims a successful Re200, superseding earlier failure response. Whether later workspace results are its delivered package requires further provenance review.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable04cd1ee build succeeds in restricted network-disabled cfd-bench; CTest has no registered tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case, output, restart and many controls; original runs explicitly override max steps300. Restart code writes current state and optional BDF history sidecar.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Numerical implementation is concentrated in a large main.cpp; reporting and postprocessing tools are separate.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal solver wrapper found; external similarity excluded under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case, CGNS mesh, boundary tags and rank-local partition control production; no two-filename-only solver branch identified.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp root-only preprocessing, METIS owned/ghost partitions, neighbour state/gradient halos and reductions; NACA rank comparison is only20 steps.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity/backtracking and recovery exist; original steady status uses drag-only 10% window with no lift test. No independent memory stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build passes; CTest reports no registered tests. Historical validator evidence does not prove numerical convergence.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Code is monolithic and original raw/manifest evidence is excluded from curated tip; report figures and source remain.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: main.cpp:289–345 and report.tex describe perfect-gas conservative NS, Rusanov and viscous terms.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS geometry, cell-face adjacency, boundary families, METIS partition and owned/ghost geometry implemented; independent mesh oracle not run.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: main.cpp:948 onward assembles face residual and global norms. Original 300-step steady residual targets remain unmet and plateau uses drag-only 10% criterion.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and optional HLLC implemented; original report notes Rusanov production and low-Mach acoustic scaling for failed Re200.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Slip/no-slip and farfield state/flux paths exist; surface rows are documented boundary values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares limited gradients exist; original transient uses documented reconstruction slope0.1 and historic binary/source binding is limited.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiter and positivity controls implemented; no independent smooth-flow order evidence; Re200 slope0.1 disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: main.cpp:1489–1510 projects viscous wall traction tangentially. Original laminar drag very low and boundary-layer credibility weak.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Scalar/block Jacobi and CFL controls present. Historic source e7977ee tests only drag over100 rows within10% and bounded residual; no lift stability check.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF residual and frozen histories implemented; original resumed Re200 metadata records26720 BE fallback intervals for steps3281–30000 with slope0.1. Report discloses counts and marks failed; no resolved shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS root preprocessing and neighbour halos/reductions. Original np2/8 Re20 same Cd0.130384 at300, NACA comparison only20-step diagnostic.

disqualification_flags.text: Incomplete or failed run reported successful
disqualification_flags.evidence: Operator-selected final response explicitly claims periodic Re200, 30000 steps, 99.9967% inner-target fraction and zero best-effort steps; later canonical workspace metadata SHA256 0b8d7a9790fe22b69220e1491f847d5756cb92dc481fbc93037e0c6e6d321275 matches all these attributes and marks completed/statistically_periodic. Its forces SHA256 fea2faecd42c125fea8ff6641a9cf2ba1a3c0e2529934572a6b04f9ef6f687c4 t180–300 have Cd1.99932–1.99974 and Cl−0.00155019..−0.0014559; delivered force plot is flat, so no resolved vortex shedding supports the periodic label. The earlier immutable e7977ee package honestly reports failed; do not conflate the two. Historical binary and strict inner count remain unbound; no unsteady rerun. Current workspace main.cpp:2589–2597 has a late-lift amplitude condition and reports unresolved wake as failed, yet the later selected metadata says periodic with nearly flat lift. Workspace source SHA256 6edd61c1306448af63c60d696ac63ca309e4b2897e9229bd09f60f8832bf3c6b differs from curated 04cd1ee; the exact producing binary is unbound and no claim is made that this source generated the historical package.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original e7977ee retains eight packages; selected final response states seven steady structural validations and failed Re200. Curated tip excludes raw packages.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only validator accepts all eight later selected-final canonical packages and current report. Structural acceptance does not establish physical success.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Selected-final Re200 metadata says periodic but later force history is flat (DQ7); earlier package honestly failed. Three laminar steady cases remain 300-step weak plateaus; three inviscid and Re20 later packages extend to 3000/30000 steps with accuracy limitations.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Later Re20 Cd≈2.866 is more plausible than earlier 0.1309 but high and varying; low-Mach inviscid Cd0.9147 and 0.2192 and laminar ~0.0035–0.0049 remain suspect; Re200 shows no resolved shedding.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Curated compiled 36-page report contains residual, force, surface, Mach/pressure and wake figures; selected Re20 Mach image reproduces exactly from original field.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Current contestant-delivered report still describes earlier failed Re200 and 26720 BE fallbacks while later output/final claim a different run; later report figures map current output. Exact generation and historic binary remain qualified.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Selected final identifies current report and all case packages; current figure/run manifests map outputs, but TeX prose remains stale relative to later Re200 and binaries are unbound. Earlier historical report/output remain separately documented.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean immutable04cd1ee CMake build succeeds with bundled dependencies; no CTests. CLI accepts case/output/restart and rank-local state; original output packages validated historically.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:205 onward reads CGNS zones, boundaries and mixed cell geometry; :546 onward creates METIS partition and owned/ghost local data. No independent mesh numerical oracle.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: main.cpp:312–384 implements physical and Rusanov/HLLC fluxes; :948 onward assembles conservative residual, wall states and positivity. Original steady results remain poor and earlier source differs from curated.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: main.cpp:826–881 least-squares reconstruction and limiter are present. Original Re200 metadata uses slope0.1, explicitly reported; original steady production/source binding and formal order evidence remain limited.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: main.cpp:884 onward implements wall gradients and viscous treatment; :1489–1510 projects wall traction tangentially. Original steady outputs have implausible drag despite limited plateau evidence.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Scalar/block implicit and frozen-history BDF path exist. Original Re200 resumed at3280; 26720 remaining intervals used backward-Euler substeps, so produced trajectory is predominantly first order. Report states exact counts and failed shedding; actual inner logs exist. Later selected-final Re200 metadata reports zero BE substeps, unlike earlier failed attempt; historic binary remains unbound, so it is not evidence that earlier 26720 fallback intervals did not occur.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only global preprocessing, METIS local partitions and neighbour exchanges; original np2/8 cylinder at300 steps agrees, NACA comparison is only20-step diagnostic. Exact binaries unbound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Later selected-final delivery supplies 3000-step inviscid, 300-step laminar and 30000-step Re20 histories; Re20 Cd≈2.866 with varying tail is partially credible while low-Mach inviscid and laminar drags remain implausible. Re200 no shedding despite periodic label; seven other packages/fields structural OK. Case-results 2→2.5.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Later contestant-delivered PDF and plots exist; report prose describes earlier failed Re200/BE fallbacks while figure and final response reflect later run, creating traceability inconsistency. Re200 force plot is startup-compressed and no vortex street is resolved. 4→3.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case and boundary inputs are data-driven, but core solver is monolithic main.cpp with limited demonstrated extensibility to 3D/additional physics.
